summary: Gilead Sciences filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $3 billion offering of senior notes across four tranches: $500M 4.250% notes due 2028, $1B 4.400% notes due 2029, $1B 4.600% notes due 2031, and $500M 4.900% notes due 2034. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other unsecured debt. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Underwriters include Barclays, BofA, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and others. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven elements are present.
